title: Admin: employee detail
interface: Extends base.html. Employee fields; 'Přidělená zařízení' table from overview.assigned (asset_tag link to /admin/assets/<id>, type, brand, model, since assignment.started_at, protocol number); 'Čeká na potvrzení' from overview.pending; 'Historie' from overview.history. Variables: employee, overview. Czech.

uses.base: templates/base.html: Jinja layout with blocks title and content; header nav (Moje zařízení '/', for admins: /admin/assets, /admin/handovers, /admin/employees, /admin/audit), current user e-mail and a logout form POST /auth/logout; flashed messages via get_flashed_messages(with_categories=true); links /static/style.css
